enrichment.summary: The Board approves an amendment adding 92 calendar days to Johnson Controls Fire Protection's agreement, in which it serves as inspector of record (IOR) on the Fruitvale Elementary School fire and intrusion alarm replacement. The end date moves from October 31, 2020 to January 31, 2021. The text states no added cost.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $4,400 to Integral Group's Fremont High building envelope review contract
enrichment.summary: The Board approves an amendment adding $4,400 to Integral Group's agreement for the Fremont High School new construction project, raising the limit from $313,925 to $318,325. The added work includes more building envelope commissioning (checking the building's outer shell), reviewing requests for information, drawings and architect instructions about a breezeway joint.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Awards Data Media Services $50,000 to install 11 security cameras at Glenview Elementary
enrichment.summary: The Board approves a competitively bid contract with Data Media Services, the lowest responsive and responsible bidder, to install eleven exterior cameras and program the servers and software at Glenview Elementary School. The $50,000 includes a $5,000 contingency. Work is scheduled from October 29, 2020 to January 27, 2021.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
